facts.text: **REAL BROWSER + DEEP RESEARCH 2026-10-24**: `workbench/browser.py` drives `/usr/bin/chromium` via Playwright (goto/click/type/read/links/screenshot) and streams CDP screencast JPEGs over WS `/api/browser/live` (~5fps). CDP emits NOTHING for an idle page → seed a frame on connect + re-send last frame as heartbeat. crawl4ai does NOT work here (needs Playwright-managed browsers; BrowserConfig has no executable_path). `workbench/research.py` searches GitHub+GitLab+HF only, ~400 pages/min. GraphQL `totalCount` is the ONLY reliable issue population — REST `/repos/x/issues` returns mostly PULL REQUESTS in busy repos. Word-count sentiment over issue text is useless as a primary signal (issue text is inherently negative) → use a health score (resolution 0.40, open-pressure 0.25, recency 0.15, popularity 0.10, licence 0.10, sentiment 0.10); >=0.70 keep. `search/issues` 403s transiently at 30/min → retry 3x. NEVER evaluate a helper inside the `out.update({...})` literal that is still being built — it sees stale/missing keys.

**MODES + ALEXA + MIC 2026-10-24**: the three mode chips were DECORATIVE — `api.chat()` never sent `depth`/`search`/`council` although server.py accepted them. Now one named mode menu (8 modes) wired to real options. Alexa: `/api/transcribe` (audio model) + `/api/alexa` (reply spoken locally via SpeechSynthesis, 3 pitch/rate voice profiles). The transcription prompt MUST be strict ("write down ONLY the spoken words… if none output فارغ") or the model answers the speech instead of transcribing. `store.create_conversation()` returns the id STRING not a dict. Mic uses MediaRecorder → /api/transcribe. Device adaptation: main.tsx sets `data-dev`/`data-touch`/`--vh` before first paint; a fixed 100vh overflows on mobile because URL bars change innerHeight. Phone mode menus must be `position:fixed;left:8px;right:8px` or they overflow at 360px.

**BIG FEATURE SET 2026-10-24**: self-repair (workbench/repair.py) = snapshot → write → VERIFY → auto-rollback; blocked paths .repair/data/.git/static/node_modules. Site builder (workbench/sites.py) two-stage preview→build. Bridge (workbench/bridge_agent.py + /ws/bridge) is CONSENT-BASED: user runs it, types yes, every command prints locally, no shell, no persistence, connection goes OUT from the user's machine. MCP server (workbench/mcp_server.py) stdio JSON-RPC with 5 tools. Telegram real (@escaidoaiopd_bot), webhook /api/telegram/webhook, NOT intercepted. UI now 9 tabs. MEASURED GOTCHAS: (a) max_tokens=8000 TRUNCATES output at ~3200 chars and 4000 fails outright → generate long HTML in ~4000-token chunks with continuation; (b) PER_MODEL_TIMEOUT 45s kills full-page generation → call_with_failover now takes `timeout=`; (c) 3 sequential site previews = 220s, asyncio.gather = 105s; (d) the live browser frame is letterboxed so click mapping must go through the drawn rect not the element box; (e) `httpx` was missing from server.py imports.

ESCaiDO ON VERCEL (2026-10-24): LIVE at https://escaido-workbench.vercel.app (stable alias -> latest production). Preview: https://escaido-workbench-giicx8h5y-klbha779-sources-projects.vercel.app. Project `escaido-workbench`, rootDirectory `workbench/ui`, Vercel token in `~/.escdo/vercel.env` (600), CLI at `~/.local/bin/vercel`. The static UI talks to the FastAPI backend cross-origin via VITE_API_BASE + ESCDO_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (CORS + SameSite=None;Secure cookie). FOUR deploy traps, in order: (1) don't set buildCommand/outputDirectory in vercel.json when using rootDirectory, Vercel then reports STATIC_BUILD_NO_OUT_DIR; (2) vite.config.ts must switch base '/ui/'->'/' and outDir '../static/ui'->'dist' when process.env.VERCEL; (3) Deployment Protection defaults to all_except_custom_domains and returns Vercel's own Next.js SSO page (`/_next/`, `data-dpl-id`) instead of the app - disable with PATCH /v9/projects/{name} {"ssoProtection":null}; (4) THE SUBTLE ONE: adding a configurable API base is not enough - grep EVERY raw `fetch('/api`, `EventSource` and `new WebSocket(` call site (Login.tsx included), not just lib/api.ts. Owner password is ESCAESCA2006 in .runtime/owner_token.txt with 6-fail/300s login lockout.
**HARD MODEL LIMITS (Lahgtna):** reference audio is TRUNCATED — `ENC_COND_LEN=6*16000` (6.0s) and
`DEC_COND_LEN=10*24000` (10.0s). Cloning from hours of audio is useless; quality comes from
cleanliness, not length. There is NO duration control in `generate()` — scene timing needs a
post-processing layer (librosa time_stretch; beyond ~20% it distorts, so split the text instead).
`max_text_tokens=2048`, `max_speech_tokens=4096`, vocab 2454, stop_token 6562.
**`language_id="iq"` is NOT wired to the Iraqi normalizer.** `tokenizer.py` maps the normalizer to
`"no"` (Norwegian code reused). `"iq"` emits an `[iq]` token with no normalization. Needs an A/B test.
EMOTION TAGS 2026-10-23 -> `detail/emotion-tag-rootcause-2026-10-23.md`: `iraqiTextUtil.clean_tags()`
rewrites `[tag]`->`<tag>` and the vocab has no `<tag>`, so tags shredded to chars.
FIX: `_itu.clean_tags = lambda t: t`. Valid: [whisper] [shhh] [laughter] [giggle] [cry] [sigh]
[gasp] [groan] [mumble] [sniff] [cough] [clear_throat] [inhale] [UH]. Invalid: laugh scream shout
sob moan pause breath stutter hes weep throat_clear.
TELEGRAM BOT: @escaidoaiopd_bot, chat_id 5399915161. Token ONLY in `~/.escdo/telegram.json` (600).
Cell templates keep `__TOKEN__`/`__CHAT__`/`__REF_IDS__`, rendered by `tools/make_cell.py`.
Details: `detail/telegram-bot-2026-10-23.md`.

PLAN v3 (`docs/plan-tts-v3.md`) is authoritative; v2 and FINAL-PLAN.md are superseded. HARD FACT: reference audio is TRUNCATED (`ENC_COND_LEN=6*16000`=6.0s, `DEC_COND_LEN=10*24000`=10.0s) so cloning from hours of audio is useless — quality comes from cleanliness, not length. Lahgtna has NO duration control; scene timing needs a post-processing layer (librosa time_stretch; >20% distorts, so split the text).

AGENT/QUOTA AUDIT 2026-10-24 -> `detail/free-quota-evidence-2026-10-24.md` + `detail/agent-audit-2026-10-24.md`: Kilo is the only keyless free API (200/hr/IP = 3.33/min, so 5-10/min sustained is impossible on one IP). `/v1/models` is public everywhere and proves NOTHING — test `/chat/completions`. OpenHands runs on LiteLLM so it is already a router. No OSS agent combines web UI + real code execution + live events + MCP + skills + memory + resume except OpenHands.
**Memory budget: ~6000 chars combined**; over budget drops lines from the TOP. Keep this file lean
and push detail into `detail/`. Check pointers resolve (`grep -o 'detail/.*\.md'`).

**NVIDIA KEY (measured 2026-10-24) -> `detail/nvidia-key-measurements-2026-10-24.md`:** works. Only 4/85 models usable: **`z-ai/glm-5.3`** (free HERE — plans claimed it was paid), `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`, **`minimaxai/minimax-m3.1-flash`** (fastest), `openai/gpt-oss-20b`. Rate limit **5 req then 429**, ~90s recovery, ~15/hr/model, per-model. Official docs URL is 404 so the limit is MEASURED (public '40 RPM' claim is wrong). glm-5.3 needs max_tokens>=1000.

**GEMINI KEY (measured 2026-10-24) -> `detail/gemini-key-measurements-2026-10-24.md`:** works via OpenAI-compatible `/v1beta/openai/chat/completions` (Bearer) so it plugs into LiteLLM directly; tool calling verified. **`"limit": 20` + `quotaId: ...PerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier` = 20 req/DAY PER MODEL**; 5 RPM. Pro is limit=0; only 5 of 46 listed models usable.

**REVISED CAPACITY 2026-10-24:** Gemini 100/day + NVIDIA ~100-400/day + Kilo 200/hr ⇒ **~300-700 req/day** vs the 1000-2000 target. Improved ~3x with the NVIDIA key but still 2-5x short — never claim the target is met.
**REPORTS written to `reports/` (2026-10-24):** ESCaiDO_BRAIN_RESEARCH.md (main, Arabic),
MODEL_COMPARISON.md, FREE_API_PROVIDERS.md, AGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md, SECURITY_AND_LIMITATIONS.md.

**UI INTEGRATION 2026-10-24**: The React RTL workbench UI now lives in `workbench/ui/` and is served at **/ui** (build output `workbench/static/ui/`); the old vanilla page stays at `/`. `src/lib/api.ts` is the only file that calls fetch. Full notes + the 6 browser-only bugs (toast never dismissed, rAF scroll-anchor race, RTL `inset-inline-end` putting the mobile drawer partly on screen, history re-populating the compose queue, SSE surviving a network drop so offline was never detected, and a prototype-CSS class mismatch that rendered the app unstyled) are in `detail/workbench-ui-2026-10-24.md`. Browser tests: `workbench/ui/e2e/*.py` (real Chromium, no mocks).

**WORKBENCH MODELS 2026-10-24**: "the models aren't connected" was really LATENCY — `gemini-3.8-flash` was first in every role chain but returns 429, so each message burned 20-37s before failover (now fastest-first + PER_MODEL_TIMEOUT=45 → ~1.5s). VISION was never wired: images must be sent as base64 `image_url` parts, not a filename note. The React app is now served at ROOT (`/legacy` = old vanilla page). Reasoning models (nemotron-3.5-super-vl) fill `reasoning_content` first, so a big token cap makes them ALWAYS time out — keep a REASONING set, cap ~700 tokens, 120s budget. Settings (theme/accent/lang/density/radius/animations/models/skills) persist in a `settings(scope,key,value)` table; `/api/models` never accepts an API key from the browser. Full detail: `detail/workbench-ui-2026-10-24.md`.

**MEDIA + ROSTER 2026-10-24**: Audio works ONLY via `input_audio` (`inline_data` → 400 on the Gemini OpenAI endpoint); video works as a `data:video/mp4;base64` URL in the ordinary `image_url` part. Only Gemini models accept these — NVIDIA silently ignores them. The provider catalogue advertises models that return **410 Gone**, so model lists must come from a live probe, never from `/v1/models`. `laguna-xs` is fastest (198ms) but intermittently 503s → use as fallback, not chain lead. The 1054 kB entry chunk was mermaid imported eagerly; `import('mermaid')` + `manualChunks` cut it to **47 kB** (DOMContentLoaded 124ms). Phone bug: the work panel is a fixed overlay under 920px and defaulted to open, covering the screen and eating taps.

**COUNCIL + AUTO-REPLACE 2026-10-24**: `workbench/council.py` runs a 5-lens panel (fact/logic/edge/risk/improve) per role; each lens is pinned to a DIFFERENT model (`DIVERSITY_POOL`) because 5 critics on one model share its blind spots. The lead synthesises and must end with "تعديلات مقبولة: N". Auto-replace: 2 consecutive failures → model benched, and only a model of the SAME ROLE is promoted (never swap a reasoning model for a cheap chat model). Kilo `https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway/v1` is KEYLESS and serves nemotron-3-ultra-550b:free — verify with a bogus-path control (HTTP 400 = genuine; HTTP 200 'OK' = proxy interception). Never send an empty Bearer token to a keyless provider.
